orgDesign.companyProfile: Belgian occupational health and safety software vendor modeled on Kitry (Kitry SA, Nivelles; specialised in occupational health and safety software since 1989, current legal entity founded 2003) after Vortex Capital Partners became its strategic partner in the buyout announced on 29 March 2022 (CEO Pierre Letargez; Vortex partner Evert Jan de Groot). At the transaction Kitry served 100+ blue-chip and public customers with about 5,400 users; Vortex now reports 150+ organisations and more than 2.5 million medical files, and kitry.com reports 4M+ employee records tracked, 6,000+ active users and more than half of employees using self-service in France, Belgium and Luxembourg (named references include SNCF, Thales, Ville de Paris, Ville de Bruxelles, Umicore, Empreva, Engie, BNP, EIB, Stellantis, EDF, RATP, CNRS, Disney and BASF). The product is a modular, multilingual (FR/NL/EN) SaaS platform - Occupational Health, Workplace Safety, Work Accidents and Occupational Diseases, Employee and Manager Portals, Monitoring and KPIs - hosted on HDS- and ISO 27001-certified shared or dedicated infrastructure with no access from outside the EEA, integrated with HRIS and SSO, Goodflag e-signature, Vonage teleconsultation, Cegedim SMS and measurement devices (Eolys, FIM, Essilor, JLM Medical, Siemens), and delivered through a four-phase implementation (functional assessment, configuration, project management, training), data migration, change management, reactive support and dedicated account managers. Kitry does not publish pricing; revenue is assumed here to come from annual module subscriptions, the hosting tier and professional services. Kitry does not publish revenue or headcount: the organisation is modeled here, as an assumption, at about 70 people.
orgDesign.operatingModel: About 70 people (assumption) organised as five small groups, each with a working group lead, and twelve teams of 3-7 people that mix software engineers with occupational health professionals and implementation consultants: the company's medical director is an occupational physician who leads the Occupational Health group and arbitrates clinical and confidentiality questions, occupational health nurses and prevention advisers act as product owners of the clinical, surveillance and safety teams, and implementation consultants who deploy the platform every week sit in the customer services group. Since the Vortex partnership in 2022 the company runs as a pure-play SaaS provider ('Kitry as a Service'): one release train for the shared and dedicated HDS/ISO 27001 SaaS environments, a regulatory release calendar per country (FR/BE/LU/NL), no customer-specific forks, and configuration through the configuration engine rather than code. Stream-aligned teams own the lifecycle Know the workforce -> Plan surveillance -> Examine and advise -> Keep the medical file -> Assess and control risks -> Handle events -> Serve employees and managers -> Prove compliance; a complicated-subsystem team owns the occupational medical file and medical confidentiality; two platform teams provide identity, configuration, audit trail, HDS hosting and the HRIS, SSO, device, telehealth, e-signature, SMS and national reporting integrations; an enabling regulatory content team keeps FR/BE/LU/NL rules, forms and periodicities current; and two enabling customer services teams run implementation, migration, training, support and account management on the same product. Team headcount sums to 61, group leads add 5, and the remaining people are the CEO, sales, marketing and finance.

teams.name: Regulatory Content

Occupational health lawyers and content specialists watch official publications, interpret changes, encode them in the configuration engine and hand every product team a validated change with its release note. Steward of the country-regulation-rule data asset.
